objectives: Students will be able to describe the importance of high-quality cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) and its impact on survival.
Students will be able to describe all steps in the Chains of Survival.
Students will be able to apply the BLS concepts of the Chains of Survival.
Students will be able to recognize the signs of someone needing CPR.
Students will be able to perform high-quality CPR for an adult, a child, and an infant.
Students will be able to describe the importance of early use of an automated external defibrillator (AED).
Students will be able to demonstrate the appropriate use of an AED.
Students will be able to provide effective ventilation by using a barrier device.

Automated External Defibrillator for Infants and Children Younger than 8 Years of Age 8.
Chocking Relief for Adults, Children, and Infants 12.
